scope: Quasistatic free body of the motor box: five parallel cords with equal tensions. Internal tendon forces also react at the palm; these moments are not net wearer/joint loads.
limitations: Actual cord angles and loads unknown.
No material strength, bolt load sharing, fatigue, local skin pressure or suspension rating established.
The arm carrier also receives palm/tendon reactions; do not treat this internal box reaction as the overall wearer torque.
